reviews.text:
I recently acquired a gecko from the store.
The service was very helpful; they explained everything I needed to do to ensure the gecko had a good life.
The animal is extremely docile due to how it was treated before.
It's a store I will definitely return to and highly recommend!!!
The place was well-organized, although small. All the animals looked well cared for! I bought two fish and they are gorgeous.

Exceptional service. I really enjoyed it. I'll be back soon. Thank you for your kindness.

My favorite store to buy things for my pets, the owners are super friendly, they explain the products and the animals very well, I highly recommend this store!
Excellent store with even better service - they take care of the customer - very rare!! 👏🏼👏🏼👏🏼👏🏼 …

I would like to commend this store. The service is simply wonderful! The person who assisted me is very friendly, attentive, and demonstrates a great deal of knowledge about the exotic animals they sell. They explain everything clearly and in detail, from the necessary care to feeding and the ideal habitat, conveying a lot of confidence.
In addition, the store has an excellent variety of quality pet food, toys, and accessories. It is evident that they care about the well-being of the animals and the satisfaction of their customers.

I recommend this store to anyone looking for professional service, quality products, and truly exceptional service. Congratulations to the entire team for the excellent work!

A wonderful place, with well-cared-for animals and environmental enrichment. They teach you from scratch how to care for the animals they sell, and they sell them with all the necessary equipment, no tricks, no scams.

The animals are kept in tiny cramped cages and don't have their needs met; gerbils and other rodents without any wheels or possibilities to move / run! The birds were visibly stressed and very depressed looking in a tiny, empty cage! To the owner and employees there: shame on you! How do you live with yourself seeing them clearly suffer? Just to make some money?

Worst experience ever. The space is absurdly small for the number of animals they have there. There's barely room for a person to move around inside, let alone to ensure the animals' well-being. The animals are kept in extremely small cages, and the stress they are subjected to is visible.
To add to the terrible space, the service is awful: arrogant, unfriendly, and completely unsympathetic employees. As if that weren't enough, on one occasion I ran into the owner/employee on the road, who insulted me and almost hit my car for letting me get too late into the life I wanted to enter (my mistake, but it wasn't a reason to insult and disrespect me in the way he did)—which perfectly shows the level of attitude of these people. Regarding the animals and the advice given:
Stressed animals: I bought two gerbils and had to take them to the vet immediately, who confirmed that they were extremely stressed because they were overcrowded in a cage that was too small in the store. Bad advice! They tried to sell me a small cage for two gerbils, guaranteeing that it was "perfectly suitable for living"

I will never return and I do not recommend it! There are many other better shops in Porto!

I only have good things to say about the shop; the owner is extremely knowledgeable about what he's talking about. There isn't the slightest bit of overcrowding among the animals, as there were in previous malicious comments. I bought a baby sugar glider, and it was extremely well cared for, just like the adult one that was there. Clean shop, friendly people, healthy animals... I won't go on, talking is easy, maintaining a shop like that is difficult. A big thank you to the owners 🙏🏼
Five-star people, very friendly and attentive. I recommend them.

Words cannot describe the service and care this store shows the animals… I ventured into the world of exotics with little knowledge and some apprehension. Thanks to the owners, I received excellent advice!! I highly recommend it! Good prices and products.
We appreciate your trust in our work.
Excellent service!!

I want to thank the store owners for their excellent service and friendliness!
Always available to help, they were the ones who introduced me to the world of exotic animals, and I am very proud of the guidance they gave me!
The store has great conditions and a wide variety of products and animals! I recommend it to everyone looking for an unusual animal!

I left the store wanting to cry!!
What a depressing place! The animals there are not in adequate conditions! I saw three bearded dragons piled on top of each other in a tiny terrarium without light! A chameleon trying to cling to the glass because it had no sticks to climb! The terrariums are not suitable for the species they have! The birds, my God… that's just cruelty!!

I will immediately file a complaint with the competent authorities; it's unacceptable that there is a place where living beings are kept in these conditions.
It is a wonderful place to know some exotic animals and some great recommendations given by the clerks

This is the first hamster I've bought from this store, on the advice of my vet. Shortly after arriving home, the hamster started making noises and became lethargic, so we took her to the vet. She was diagnosed with a respiratory infection, and shortly after, she developed abdominal swelling and diarrhea. All of this happened in less than a week. This isn't the first hamster I've had; she didn't arrive in good health.
Do you have guinea pigs?
THANK YOU FOR YOUR ATTENTION.
I managed to buy a guinea pig. The service was very good.

What an amazing place! I received excellent service, the breeder is extremely friendly and patient, and answered all my questions about reptiles without any rush.
The animals are visibly well cared for, super calm and familiar with him, which gave me a lot of confidence. I also loved the transparency; you can see that it's not the kind of place that sells just for the sake of selling. The prices are very affordable.
I haven't bought anything yet, but I'll definitely be back to get my reptile from there. I highly recommend it! 🦎🐍

I've bought several animals and various pieces of equipment there, and I have nothing negative to point out, only positive things and 5 stars. They have many types of products and many types of animals; everything I need and am looking for I find there. Good service and beautiful, super well-cared-for animals.
The shop was too small for so much stuff; it looked like a bird market, everything was crammed together.

I've been a customer for about 6 years, and I highly recommend it to anyone who loves animals. The service is 5-star, the advice is 5-star, and they provide continuous support regarding animals and everything else they sell in the store. The staff are respectful, kind, and approachable. If you have a child, bring them along! Children who love animals, as I've experienced, will be amazed by the rabbits, hamsters, piglets, squirrels, iguanas, turtles, geckos, and other animals and related items in the store. A visit is worthwhile. (Vítor Silva, customer with 23 animals purchased there), thank you very much to the couple for all these years of excellent service and always available friendship. #
